item.description: High-end network security consulting in Munich. Firewall migration, Zero Trust architecture, and network automation. Free initial technical consultation.
item.content:encoded:
Network Security & Infrastructure Consulting for Enterprises

In today’s complex threat landscape, your network infrastructure must do more than just “work”—it must be resilient, transparent, and secure. With over 11 years of experience as a Senior Network Security Engineer, I modernize your critical infrastructure according to global standards.

Based in Munich, I bring expertise from high-security sectors like banking and industry directly to your business.

💬 Free Initial Technical Consultation (30 Min): Message on WhatsApp or Send an Email

Core Competencies & Solutions

1. Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) Management

Your firewall is the first line of defense. I provide not just installation, but optimization based on best-practice standards:

  • Palo Alto & Fortinet Migration: Seamless migration from legacy systems to modern NGFW platforms with Zero Downtime.
  • Policy Optimization: Cleaning up complex rulebases to boost system performance and security.
  • SSL Inspection: Gaining visibility into hidden threats within encrypted traffic.

2. Zero Trust & Secure Access Architecture

Modernizing your network based on the principle of “Never trust, always verify”:

  • Micro-Segmentation: Limiting lateral movement within the network to prevent the spread of security breaches.
  • Secure Remote Access (VPN/ZTNA): Implementing Palo Alto GlobalProtect or Fortinet ZTNA for secure mobile work.
  • Identity Management (Cisco ISE / Aruba ClearPass): Automated verification of identity and security posture for every device on the network.

3. Data Center & Campus Network Design

High-speed infrastructures for modern requirements:

  • Cisco NDFC & VXLAN: Scalable and flexible fabric architectures for modern data centers.
  • High Availability (HA): Redundant designs to ensure continuous operation during hardware or software failures.
  • SD-WAN Implementation: Cost-effective and intelligent wide-area network management for global sites.

4. Network Automation (NetDevOps)

Modern approaches that eliminate manual errors and increase speed:

  • Python-based Automation: Executing policy changes or inventory audits on hundreds of devices simultaneously.
  • Configuration Backup & Monitoring: Comprehensive logging of every change in your infrastructure for audits and compliance.

Typical Project Sizes & Investment

Every business is different—here is an orientation framework:

Project Type Scope Investment
Firewall Audit & Optimization 1-2 Days from €500
WLAN Planning (up to 50 APs) 3-5 Days from €900
Firewall Migration (Palo Alto / Fortinet) 5-10 Days from €2,000
Zero Trust Architecture Project-based On Request
Monthly Managed Security Monitoring Ongoing from €199/mo

Free estimate provided after a 30-minute initial call. No hidden costs.

Why Professional Consulting?

  • Senior Expertise: I apply bank-level security protocols to your corporate environment.
  • Vendor-Neutral Approach: I objectively recommend only the technology you truly need (Cisco, Palo Alto, Fortinet, etc.).
  • Sustainability: I provide full documentation for all systems, ensuring your infrastructure remains transparent and manageable.
  • GDPR Compliant: All solutions are implemented considering German data protection requirements.

Schedule a Consultation Now

The initial consultation (30 min) is free and non-binding. You will receive a clear, transparent offer afterward.

On-Site IT Care – Complete IT Support for Your Business

You focus on your business — I’ll take care of your IT.

Small and medium businesses don’t need their own IT department. They need a reliable contact who shows up when something isn’t working, who acts proactively before something fails — and who explains clearly what they’re doing.

As a Senior IT Engineer with over 11 years of experience, that’s exactly what I offer: personal, professional IT support on-site in Munich and surrounding areas.

💬 Free IT analysis: Write on WhatsApp — I’ll assess your current IT situation at no cost.

Services Overview

📶 WiFi Optimization & Mesh Network (Aruba Instant On)

The problem: WiFi drops out, there’s no signal in the back room, customers complain about slow internet.

The solution: I analyze your premises and install professional Aruba Instant On Access Points — without replacing your existing modem.

  • Mesh technology: Access points connect automatically — no complicated cable runs required
  • Separate networks: Staff WiFi and guest WiFi cleanly separated — GDPR-compliant and secure
  • Cloud management: All devices monitored via an app — I see immediately if something is wrong
  • Scalable: Need more coverage later? Simply add another access point

Suitable for: Cafés, restaurants, medical practices, law firms, small offices, hotels

Service Price
Site survey (signal analysis) Free
Installation 1x Aruba AP From €99 + hardware
Installation 2x AP (Mesh) From €149 + hardware
Monthly monitoring €19/month

💾 NAS Backup & Data Security (AWS S3)

The problem: Many businesses have a NAS device without RAID — a single hard drive failure and all data is lost. Or: the NAS is running but there’s no external backup.

The solution: I set up automatic, encrypted data backup from your NAS directly to AWS Cloud (Frankfurt).

  • Automatic: Daily backup without manual intervention
  • Encrypted: Your data is encrypted before transfer — only you have the key
  • Your AWS account: I set everything up in your name — the data and account belong to you
  • GDPR-compliant: Servers in Frankfurt (EU), no data sharing with third parties
  • Affordable: 100 GB in AWS S3 costs approximately €2-3 per month

For medical practices & law firms: I prepare a Data Processing Agreement (AVV) — legally clean and GDPR-compliant.

Service Price
AWS account setup €49 one-time
Backup configuration (Hyper Backup) €49 one-time
AVV preparation (for medical practices) €29 one-time
Monthly monitoring & control €19/month

AWS costs (~€2-5/month) are billed directly through your AWS account.

🔋 UPS – Uninterruptible Power Supply

The problem: A power outage or voltage spike can permanently damage your server, NAS or network devices and cause data loss — often without warning.

The solution: A UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) protects your devices from power outages and voltage surges.

How it works:

Power goes out
      ↓
UPS kicks in immediately (battery)
      ↓
NAS detects the outage automatically
      ↓
Safe shutdown within 2 minutes
      ↓
No data loss, no damage
  • Recommendation: APC or Eaton Line-Interactive UPS
  • NAS integration: Synology NAS detects UPS automatically via USB and shuts down safely
  • Annual battery check: I check the battery condition once a year
Service Price
UPS needs analysis Free
Installation & NAS integration €59 labor
UPS hardware (APC 650VA) ~€80-120 + margin
Annual battery check €29/year

🛡️ Antivirus & Endpoint Protection (Centrally Managed)

The problem: A single antivirus program on each PC is not enough. Ransomware, phishing and modern attacks bypass simple solutions easily.

The solution: I install a centrally managed EDR/antivirus solution (e.g. Bitdefender GravityZone or ESET Protect) on all your devices.

  • Central management: I see the protection status of all devices at a glance
  • Real-time protection: Threats are detected before they cause damage
  • Ransomware protection: Your files are protected from encryption by malware
  • Monthly report: You receive a monthly overview of detected threats
Service Price
Setup & installation (up to 5 PCs) €59 one-time
License per device From €3-5/month
Monthly management & report Included in package

📹 Camera System & Video Surveillance

The problem: You want to monitor your entrance, cash register or warehouse — but don’t know which system is right for you.

The solution: I install a professional IP camera system that fits your situation — easy to use, reliable and GDPR-compliant.

  • Synology Surveillance Station: If you already have a Synology NAS, we can use it as a video recorder — 2 camera licenses are included free
  • IP cameras: Hikvision or Dahua — reliable and cost-effective
  • Remote access: View your cameras anytime via smartphone app
  • GDPR: I help with correct signage and privacy policy
Service Price
Consultation & planning Free
Installation per camera From €49 labor
Synology Surveillance Station setup €59 one-time
Additional camera license (Synology) ~€50 one-time

💻 PC & Server Maintenance

The problem: Slow computers cost productivity every day. Outdated systems are security risks.

The solution: Regular maintenance keeps your devices fast, secure and reliable.

  • Windows reinstallation: Clean system, optimized drivers, no data loss
  • Hardware upgrade: SSD and RAM — up to 5x faster without buying a new PC
  • Windows Update management: All security updates centrally and controlled
  • Server maintenance: Replace RAM/drives, clean fans, check logs
  • Remote support: Simple problems solved via AnyDesk without an on-site visit

PC diagnosis Free
Windows reinstallation From €49
SSD/RAM upgrade From €49 + hardware
Server maintenance (on-site) €59/hour
Remote support €29/hour

Monthly Care Packages

Instead of individual jobs, I also offer monthly care contracts — so you always have a fixed contact person and predictable IT costs:

Your Data — Always Under Your Control

As with all my services: All accounts belong to you.

  • AWS account in your name

I only receive administrator access for management purposes. You retain full control — always.

item.content:encoded:
Web Shield – Professional Website Protection & Management

Your website is often the first impression potential customers have of your business. A crash, a cyberattack, or an expired SSL certificate can cost you customers and trust — often without you even noticing.

Web Shield is a monthly all-inclusive protection plan for your business website: security, maintenance, backups, and monitoring — all from one person, so you never have to worry about it.

💬 Free website analysis: Write on WhatsApp — I’ll check your website for vulnerabilities at no cost.

What’s Included?

🔒 SSL Certificate – Always Valid, Never Expired

An expired SSL certificate shows your visitors the warning “This site is not secure” — and they leave immediately.

  • Automatic setup and renewal
  • No manual action required
  • Your site is always accessible with the green padlock

🛡️ WAF – Web Application Firewall

A WAF protects your website from the most common attacks: SQL injection, cross-site scripting (XSS), bot attacks, and more.

  • OWASP security ruleset activation
  • Automatic blocking of suspicious requests
  • 24/7 protection against hacking attempts

⚡ DDoS Protection – Your Website Stays Online

DDoS attacks flood your website with requests until it crashes. With our protection, these attacks are automatically repelled — before they cause damage.

  • Unlimited DDoS protection
  • Automatic detection and mitigation
  • No downtime from attacks

🌐 Free Hosting (for eligible websites)

Are you still paying monthly for hosting at Ionos, Strato, or another provider?

For many simple business websites, we can migrate hosting entirely to Cloudflare Pages — free, faster, and more secure than traditional hosting.

  • No more monthly hosting costs
  • Global CDN — your site loads fast worldwide
  • Automatic deployments when changes are made

Note: Suitable for static websites and simple business pages. Complex WordPress or e-commerce systems stay with existing hosting — but still receive WAF and DDoS protection.

📊 Monthly Security Report

Every month you receive a clear report by email:

Your Website Report – March 2026
──────────────────────────────────
✅ SSL Certificate: Valid (340 days)
✅ Uptime: 99.98%
🛡️ Blocked attacks: 127
⚡ DDoS attempts repelled: 3
👥 Total visitors: 1,847
🌍 Top countries: Germany, Austria, Switzerland
⚡ Average load time: 0.7 sec

See at a glance that your website is protected and performing well.

🔑 Your Credentials – Always Under Your Control

This is especially important to us: All accounts belong to you.

For each client we set up their own account:

  • Cloudflare account in your name → DNS, WAF, SSL, Hosting
  • GitHub account in your name → Your website files
  • Password Manager (Bitwarden) → All credentials stored securely

I only receive an administrator access — so I can handle the management. You retain full control at all times. Should you wish to end the service, everything belongs to you. No lock-in, no hidden dependencies.

Who Is Web Shield For?

  • Medical practices & therapists — GDPR-compliant protection for patient contact forms
  • Law firms — Protecting confidential client inquiries

I have WordPress — does this work too? Yes. WAF and DDoS protection work with any website. WordPress updates and backups are included in the Business package.
